correctness.rationale: With V=v_rest+I0 and 0<=u<V, v(t) increases to V. Solving dTheta/dv+(Theta-f(v))/(tau(V-v))=0 yields a homogeneous difference D(v)=((V-v)/(V-u))^(1/tau)(q1-q0)>0. Before a lower leg first positive-to-negative threshold crossing, the higher leg remains above it, so its kth crossing (if any) has strictly larger voltage; if the lower leg never resets, the higher cannot. After each reset both restart at voltage 0, with thresholds ordered by r+Delta. Because I0 is constant, absolute times disappear, so the argument inducts across arbitrarily many finite spikes. Independently differentiated the integrating factor and verified the homogeneous ODE symbolically; grazing contacts are excluded. No claim extends to phase-dependent periodic forcing.
